Short Description:
This project aims to develop an advanced system for analyzing and forecasting airline delays by integrating multiple data sources. Utilizing Pandas for data manipulation, Prophet for time series forecasting, and anomaly detection techniques, the system provides insights into delay patterns and predicts future delays.

Python Code:

# multi_source_airline_operations_analytics_and_delay_forecasting.py

import pandas as pd
from prophet import Prophet
from pyod.models.iforest import IForest
from sklearn.preprocessing import LabelEncoder
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Load dataset
df: pd.DataFrame = pd.read_csv('flight_delay_data.csv')

# Preprocessing
df['FlightDate'] = pd.to_datetime(df['FlightDate'])
df['Delay'] = df['ArrDelay'].fillna(0)
df = df[['FlightDate', 'Delay']]

# Time Series Forecasting with Prophet
df_prophet: pd.DataFrame = df.rename(columns={'FlightDate': 'ds', 'Delay': 'y'})
model: Prophet = Prophet()
model.fit(df_prophet)
future: pd.DataFrame = model.make_future_dataframe(periods=30)
forecast: pd.DataFrame = model.predict(future)

# Anomaly Detection
df_anomaly: pd.DataFrame = df.copy()
df_anomaly['Delay'] = df_anomaly['Delay'].fillna(0)
model_iforest: IForest = IForest()
model_iforest.fit(df_anomaly[['Delay']])
df_anomaly['anomaly'] = model_iforest.predict(df_anomaly[['Delay']])

# Visualization
plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))
plt.plot(df['FlightDate'], df['Delay'], label='Actual Delay')
plt.plot(forecast['ds'], forecast['yhat'], label='Forecasted Delay')
plt.legend()
plt.xlabel('Date')
plt.ylabel('Delay (minutes)')
plt.title('Flight Delay Forecast')
plt.show()

# Save forecast to CSV
forecast[['ds', 'yhat', 'yhat_lower', 'yhat_upper']].to_csv('flight_delay_forecast.csv', index=False)
